question: What mantra and power are to be placed on the right arm?
premises: The power of splendor is specified.
The mantra to Bhava ends with obeisance.
The placement is on the right arm.
inference: One should place splendor and the Bhava mantra ending with obeisance on the right arm.
plain_english: One should place splendor and the mantra to Bhava ending with obeisance on the right arm.
